summary: The market is edging off its lows. The Nifty has climbed back above 22,650 after dipping near 22,600, but the rebound is shallow and most sectors are still red.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma (+0.36%) and Healthcare, led by Dr Reddy's and Sun Pharma
detail.laggards: FMCG, Auto (−1%+), Chemicals; HCLTech, Bajaj Finance, Tata Motors PV, HDFC Life
detail.tone: Slightly better than 11:00: the Nifty was 22,619.90 (−0.70%) at 11:00, and the latest headline has it above 22,650 with the Sensex about 400 pts off its low. This is the first sign of buyers stepping in today.
watch: Whether the Nifty can reclaim 22,700 before expiry settlement
Banks: a turn in HDFC Bank or ICICI would confirm the bounce
Any move in Brent or US futures
